test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33eb710da5c05b1a2e9b02bbf44de606ecb708cf4a435620c8252c7bb8863a0b.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: Step I: Symbol 'Arrow' are getting shifted one place in clockwise direction.

Step II: Symbol 'Rectangle' are getting rotated and shifted one place in clockwise direction.

Step III: Symbol 'Diamond' are getting shifted one place in anti-clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/710f569ce06c22f1962615304665aadc0568eeec4479e8d14c8765b8cb37ec3f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e911553fe92e39d9bf27f0ef63946969b6e273d00c63fe0cabd4b92036c0e41.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/248dbc317981376ed33543acdaccb8979c0069e0105b51287f61d1ae86a5e0c4.png] 

 

The complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9943bbe26963f81561d9ce57990247b46d7d723ff3eb019a45e6581ef1039ab.png] 

So, 'Option 1' will replace the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
